title: Quenched German Sauser Pilaf
description: Umami-rich pilaf with chewy texture, featuring tobiko, wok-hei, and halal-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of wok hei-infused sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of halal chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until rice is cooked and most of liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork and stir in cooked, diced chicken breast, tobiko, and a pinch of curry powder.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle with additional wok hei-infused sesame oil, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
